summary: TAT Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, reporting its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results. The press release details revenues of $41.1 million, gross profit of $10.0 million, operating income of $3.0 million, net income of $3.4 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $4.9 million. Backlog and long-term agreements reached approximately $580 million. Management comments on supply chain disruptions and expects growth to resume in the second half of 2026. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change is announced.
